SUBMITTED.title: Study plan sent to your advisor on {{date}}
SUBMITTED.description: You cannot change the plan while your advisor reviews it. If something needs fixing, contact your advisor and ask them to return the plan.

ADVISOR_APPROVED.title: Study plan approved
ADVISOR_APPROVED.description: Changes are only possible during add/drop in the first two weeks of the semester.

LOCKED.title: Study plan closed
LOCKED.description: Registration for the semester is over. Contact the registrar's office about any changes.

windowClosed.title: Registration window is closed
windowClosed.description: You cannot change the study plan now. The registrar's office publishes registration dates.

sections.mandatoryHint: Added to the plan automatically. Where there are several teachers, you choose.
sections.electivesHint: Chosen from the elective catalogue of your programme.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}” from your plan?
remove.description: Your seat will be released and given to the first student on the waitlist. You can only add the course back if seats remain.

checks.title: Check before sending
checks.ok: No issues — the plan can be sent to your advisor

code.CREDITS_BELOW_MIN: Credits taken: {{total}}, but at least {{min}} are required. Add electives from the catalogue.
code.CREDITS_ABOVE_MAX: Credits in the plan: {{total}}, but no more than {{max}} are allowed. Remove an elective or contact the registrar's office.
code.PREREQ_NOT_MET: “{{name}}”: prerequisites not completed. Contact your advisor.
code.WAITLIST_PENDING: “{{name}}”: you are on the waitlist, position {{position}}. Credits count once a seat frees up.
code.OFFERING_BELOW_MIN: “{{name}}”: {{taken}} enrolled, minimum is {{min}}. If the group does not fill, you will be offered another one.

submit.blocked: Sending becomes available once the issues listed above are fixed.
submit.title: Send the study plan to your advisor?
submit.description: You cannot change the plan while your advisor reviews it. If your advisor returns it, you can edit it again.
submit.done: Study plan sent to your advisor

returned.title: Advisor {{advisor}} returned your study plan for changes

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.description: Change the query or reset the filters.

prereqBlocked.title: Prerequisites not completed
prereqBlocked.description: You cannot enrol in this course. Your advisor can waive the requirement with a comment — contact them.

readOnly.title: You cannot change your choice now
readOnly.description: The study plan has been sent to your advisor, approved, or the registration window is closed.

discipline.offeringsHint: You choose a teacher together with their group: each has its own language, format and number of seats.

noOfferings.title: No sections yet
noOfferings.description: The department has not yet assigned teachers to this course for the semester.

offering.belowMin: The group opens once at least {{min}} students enrol
offering.languageNotAllowed: Unavailable: this language is not one of your languages of instruction

replaceToWaitlist.title: Move to the waitlist?
replaceToWaitlist.description: This teacher has no seats left. Your seat with {{teacher}} will be released immediately, and a new one appears only if someone drops out.

offering.waitlistAnnounce: You are on the waitlist for {{teacher}}, position {{position}}

history.title: Study plan history
history.autoMandatory: Mandatory courses for the semester were added to the plan automatically

ical.hint: Add the link to Google Calendar, Outlook or your phone calendar — timetable changes arrive automatically, no need to resubscribe.

held.title: Attendance mark
held.hint: The mark is used to count teaching load and will become the basis of the attendance register.
held.future: You can mark a class as held on the day or later.

requests.title: Substitution requests
requests.subtitle: Requests go to the department. The timetable changes once the department approves them.
requests.empty: No requests yet. You can report that you cannot teach a class from its card in the timetable.

form.title: Report that you cannot teach
form.hint: The request goes to the department. Until the department approves it, the class stays in the timetable.
form.commentHint: For example, who could substitute, or a convenient time to reschedule.
form.commentRequired: Describe the reason — the department cannot decide without it

decision.moved: The department moved the class to {{date}}, period {{slot}}
